lines.trans: I always knew I would be a chef.
Not a firefighter and not an astronaut.
Not even president. Exactly a chef.
Here he is, our hero!
I really liked your solyanka.
Thank you! I tried very hard.
Well done. Practically a masterpiece out of nothing.
Would you like to work in a good restaurant?
Of course! That is my dream.
You are welcome. I will be glad.
I am speaking completely seriously.
In which restaurant?
Restaurant Claude Monet in Moscow.
Thank you very much! I will definitely come.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: a brave person; also the main character of a story

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall
вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
как у космонавта = in peak physical shape

examples.text: Сто двадцать на восемьдесят, как у космонавта!
examples.trans: One hundred and twenty over eighty, like an astronaut!

meanings.note: сон is a dream while sleeping

examples.trans: If there are questions, you are welcome.

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child
goes right before the word it negates
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.trans: I'll definitely buy you a tank.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.
Fire engines and police are everywhere!

meanings.en: to be liked, to make a good impression
meanings.note: person who likes is in the dative

examples.text: Синеозерск понравился в Москве больше других мест.
examples.trans: In Moscow they liked Sineozersk more than other places.

meanings.en: to do some work, to work for a bit

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.
I'll do some work at home.
This is practically impossible to do.

meanings.note: head of a country or a company

examples.trans: The president is speaking on TV.
Who is the president of the company?
Security will be here any moment.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness
short form only: рад, рада, радо, рады; no long-form cases

examples.trans: I'm very glad to see you.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.

examples.trans: There is hot solyanka for lunch today.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.trans: He always tries to help his friends.
